evidence: All date fields are input[type=month]; preview renders consistent "Mon YYYY" format for both experience ("Mar 2020 - Jun 2023") and education ("Sep 2014 - May 2018"). Checking "I currently work here" on a position with end=2023-06 cleared the value to "" and set disabled=true; preview showed "Aug 2023 - Present".

Contact fields (name/email/phone/location/linkedin/website) and summary edited and reflected in preview. Education: added 2 (MIT, Boston University), edited, reordered via ↑, deleted a 3rd. issue: Customized Summary section heading is not rendered in the Minimal template
actual: Sections tab lets the user rename headings. Renamed Summary→"About Me", Experience→"Career History", Education→"Academics", Skills→"Core Skills". Modern preview shows "About Me / Career History / Academics / Core Skills" and Classic shows "ABOUT ME / CAREER HISTORY / ACADEMICS / CORE SKILLS", but the Minimal preview renders only "CAREER HISTORY / ACADEMICS / CORE SKILLS" — the summary body text appears with no heading. DOM check of the Minimal preview root: innerHTML does not contain "About Me"/"ABOUT ME"; headings list is [H1:Alice Tester, H2:CAREER HISTORY, H3..., H2:ACADEMICS, H3..., H2:CORE SKILLS].

evidence: Sections tab provides up/down reorder buttons and visibility switches. Moving "Core Skills" up placed it before "Academics" in the preview. Toggling the Academics switch off removed the whole Education section from the preview; toggling it back on restored it in the new position.

Reorder (Skills above Education) and visibility toggle each updated the live preview in the same render with no save/refresh. After navigating Sections → Contact tab, the preview still showed the custom order (About Me, Career History, Core Skills, Academics) with Academics visible again.

Typing contact fields, summary, experience, education and skills updated the "Live Preview" pane immediately with no save button or refresh. Selecting Classic/Minimal/Modern templates re-rendered the preview instantly.

"Hide Preview" removed the Live Preview pane (button toggled to "Show Preview"); "Show Preview" restored it with all editor content, custom section order/headings and Modern template selection intact.

issue: No validation feedback when renaming to an empty/whitespace-only title
actual: Renaming the resume to "   " (whitespace) and to "" (empty) and pressing Enter silently reverts to the previous title "Untitled Resume". The title is correctly preserved, but no error message, toast, or inline validation is shown: the Notifications region stays empty ("none"), no inline error text appears while the empty value is in the input, and the input carries no aria-invalid state.

actual: Dashboard path: card menu → Rename → set title to "   " → Save. evidence: Card menu → Duplicate created "QA Engineer Resume (Copy)" with all source content. Renamed it to "Senior QA Lead Resume". Edited the copy (name → "Alice COPY Tester", summary → "COPY summary: ..."); reopening the original "QA Engineer Resume" showed it still had "Alice Tester" and the original summary.

All 6 coexist on the dashboard with independent content, titles and template badges.

Search "qa engineer" (lowercase) matched "QA Engineer Resume"; "RESUME" (uppercase) matched all 6 — case-insensitive. Clearing the box restored all 6 resumes. Sort combobox offers Newest First / Oldest First: Newest First gave [Startup Application, Senior QA Lead, QA Engineer (Aug 28 2026), Product Designer (Feb 25 2024), Marketing Manager (Feb 10 2024), Software Engineer (Jan 20 2024)]; Oldest First produced the exact reverse ordering.

issue: Date filtering feature is entirely absent from the dashboard
actual: The dashboard offers only a title search box and a sort combobox (Newest/Oldest First, Title A-Z/Z-A). There are no date filter controls: zero input[type=date|month|datetime-local] elements, the only input on the page is the "Search resumes..." textbox, and no date-picker/range buttons exist. Searching a date string ("Feb 10, 2024") that matches a card's displayed date returns "No resumes found / Try a different search term", so there is no way to narrow by an exact creation date or a creation-date range, and therefore no date criterion to clear.

issue: No persistence — all resume changes are lost on reload; app resets to seeded demo data
actual: Before reload the dashboard held 5 resumes: created "QA Engineer Resume", duplicated+renamed "Senior QA Lead Resume", and the 3 seeded ones, with "Startup Application Resume" deleted. After reloading http://localhost:6005/ only the 3 original seeded resumes remain (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer). The created resume, the duplicate, the rename and all content edits are gone, and the deleted resume's removal was also not persisted (state simply reset). localStorage and sessionStorage are both empty (no keys), confirming state is in-memory only.
